components.summary: Shared package constants, lazy exports, explicit artifact IO and the read-only iteration and source-ownership kernels.
responsibilities: Publish suite constants and lazily load each native member API without importing optional desktop dependencies.
Bind frozen predictions to canonical model content, select terminal reasons and compare gap lineage without writing model files.
Project source-owned copied fields consistently for drift checks and explicit handoff refreshes.
state: package version and frozen prediction identities
side_effects: Write explicitly requested JSON artifacts through the common CLI helper; iteration and ownership projections do not modify models

components.summary: Own the researchguard console and the four member command lines; dispatch each member command directly to its owner.
responsibilities: Dispatch researchguard logic|source|trace|experiment straight to the member main; unknown commands return one typed JSON error.

Own member command lines, including stable source stop rules, trace iteration direction and report/gaps/compare research-state views while retaining complete JSON output. Expose plain results with model freshness and no result identities. Require the viewer extra and tkinter only for the desktop viewer; reject the retired projectradar simulation mode.
Pass the already-loaded trace model into logic handoff export so the native CLI carries actual evidence content and polarity.
Expose score-actions from the same complete native plan scoring path as plan --all-scores, without a candidate limit.
Compare versions of one source model using actual gap semantic fields and nested qualification decision; self-comparison reports no change and retired gap.status stays rejected.
Create complete synthetic source and trace starter models whose sample data and evidence boundaries stay explicit.

Expose canonical --source-id intake/import and --source-model provenance checking; retire the unconsumed SourceGuard LogicGuard export. Dispatch status to the read-only research tree view while retaining member help and version formats. Expose --into on source-to-trace and trace-to-logic handoffs, requiring a distinct output file.
side_effects: member commands perform their existing explicit file writes

components.summary: LogicGuard: argument licensing, the source library and arguments inside written artifacts.
responsibilities: Group native argument licensing, personal source work and artifact argument auditing under one member.

components.summary: Source belief states, anchors, search frontiers and native stop decisions.
responsibilities: Own evidence discovery, expected-utility search plans, stop decisions, source/anchor qualification and readable source/anchor/closure reporting. Return SourceDepthResult with actual model freshness and native coverage, without result versions, result-model or universe self-hashes.
Load, plan, update and iterate on a model file alone; models carry no contract; the action and every protected or coverage gap a prediction names must exist in the model when it is frozen.

Decide whether to keep searching from the model itself: all executable declared and generated actions, selecting an affordable target by native utility, the open blocking gaps and the caller-declared budget.
Combine source semantic-state, depth and coverage gaps from each actual model and delegate transition sets to the shared suite helper; resolved obligations alone count as progress.
Read all recorded observations for native depth and preview a new observation only on a clone; current-call provider status remains explicit.
Generate gap queries from the gap description and at most two domain hints, bounded to 120 characters; preserve executable declared actions and suppress their generated duplicates.

Default only absent gap semantic_state to discovered, keep retired status invalid, and warn on synthetic starter ids during validation. Be the sole owner of source ids, roles, lineage and anchors; export a TraceGuard seed, with no unconsumed LogicGuard candidate export. Refresh source-owned trace copies by identity while preserving downstream fields; claim-usable anchors are trace-usable.
state: source beliefs: sources, anchors, gaps, actions and stop rules
side_effects: Write explicit source models, TraceGuard seeds and source reports; refresh only source-owned copies

components.summary: Temporal and causal trace inference, storyline depth, ablations and trace-to-logic handoff.
responsibilities: Own temporal and causal trace inference, storyline stress, case library updates and readable timeline/hypothesis/depth reporting. Expose native inference/depth results with model freshness only; handoffs carry source-model freshness and case writeback stores gaps and contradictions without solver histories. Use neutral undeclared evidence types and model-authored finite strength tables consistently across every factor; preserve case model declarations.
Keep command output to analysis results; full JSON is written only with --output.
Solve storyline support from evidence first; bound causal support below it. Depth checks that neither causal declarations nor oppose links raise support; evaluate does not run depth.
Freeze with an existing target and coverage; permit future expected evidence/event ids. Append typed observation rows in memory and compare canonical target support direction.

Preserve newly observed rows in candidates; acceptance is independent of native depth closure. Keep prediction mismatches separate from native gaps, use the suite lineage helper and count only resolved native gaps as progress.
Export hypothesis ids, native rank/support and signed evidence with original text/source/locator alongside the preserved v1 trace claims.
state: trace models, events, storyline hypotheses, ablations and trace case-library data
side_effects: Write explicitly requested trace models, logic bundles, iteration results and case-library files

components.summary: Finite experiment discrimination, observation updates and bounded terminal decisions.
responsibilities: Distinguish hypotheses within the declared finite count limit; minimize optional declared costs before count and IDs, retain cost mode in remaining recommendations, and exclude the selected set from alternatives. Report limit failures separately from truly indistinguishable pairs. Return experiment dispositions and revision proposals without matrix self-fingerprints.
License native closure only for a unique consistent hypothesis with no holdout counterexample and no gaps, while preserving the finite iteration limit first; holdout observations are optional.

Continue a bounded multi-survivor iteration only with a concrete distinguishing next candidate; preserve valid construction eliminations across matrix misses and never close zero survivors. Do not infer historical progress from unchanged gaps; malformed specs return one JSON error.
Load native experiment specifications and observations for both the CLI and research folder view.
state: experiment specifications, predictions and explicit observations
side_effects: Write an explicitly requested experiment recommendation or observation report

components.summary: Own skill installation by copy, privacy checks and the route-file prompt budgets.
responsibilities: Own ordinary package/skill installation, privacy checks, prompt budgets and source validation.
side_effects: copy the researchguard skill folder into the given skills directory and remove retired member skill folders

components.summary: One research question: cross-route identities, copy drift, ablations, candidate comparison and one verdict for writers.
responsibilities: Load the research index and resolve source-library provenance through the native validator.
Detect copied-content drift and direct evidence or conclusion disagreements between native routes.
Apply declared anchor ablations in memory and expose uncaught known-bad cases.
Project the authoritative search stop and root wording license into one five-key verdict; compare current and candidate questions without writing models.
The question model lists live hypotheses and contested routes from route states.
state: loaded research index, native models and optional source library
side_effects: Read indexed model/library files and write only an explicit status --output

components.summary: Native argument evaluation, wording licenses, provenance and task-local argument iteration.
responsibilities: Evaluate bounded argument support and attacks, preserve block hierarchy and report deletion-minimal wording licenses.
Validate content-bound evidence provenance using the canonical source and library resolver.
Refresh copied handoff provenance without changing author text, edges or unrelated records; iterate on explicit candidates.
state: argument models, confidence and explicit evidence provenance
side_effects: Write argument reports and explicit candidate artifacts only through member commands

components.summary: Personal source library, per-source argument models and optional desktop browsing.
responsibilities: Import and deduplicate source material, maintain per-source models and project reading lists.
Browse and export the personal source library without requiring the optional viewer for core commands.
state: source-library files, project reading lists and node search indexes
side_effects: Create or replace explicitly requested library content, indexes, packages and viewer exports

components.summary: Arguments inside written artifacts and an argument-ordered unit plan for writing tools.
responsibilities: Audit structured artifacts and citation coverage against native argument models.
Produce the stable synthesis-request.v1 and synthesis-plan.v1 bridge; writing tools own outlines and delivery.
state: structured artifacts, citation mappings and synthesis requests
side_effects: Write only explicitly requested structure, citation and synthesis reports

flows.summary: Dispatch one native member through the single console.
Read the question and present its native-route verdict.
License wording from native support and attacks.
Decide whether the complete native search frontier warrants continuing.
Refresh source-owned copies while preserving downstream reasoning.
Observe a frozen argument prediction bound to its baseline identity.
Observe one search outcome against its frozen prediction and choose the terminal reason.
Compare a frozen trace prediction with a later observation and choose the terminal reason.
Eliminate hypotheses from experiment observations and choose the terminal reason.
